body:
### Question

Hello uv Support Team,

I am using Windows 11 and Python 3.14 in Visual Studio Code.

When I try to install NLTK using pip, I get this error:

error: externally-managed-environment

The error says that my Python installation is managed by uv and should not be modified.

Also, when I run my Python file, I get ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'nltk' because NLTK is installed in a different Python environment.

Could you please guide me on the correct way to install packages and configure Python in VS Code?

Thank you.
 Copy message

### Platform

Windows 11 x86_64

### Version

uv 0.12.17 (635500036 2026-09-18 x86_64-pc-windows-msvc)
title: Python 3.14 NLTK Installation Error on Windows 11
